# Apurv Singhal — AI Engineer & Builder

> Machine-readable profile for LLM crawlers, search engines, and AI agents.

Apurv Singhal is an enterprise engineer with 8+ years shipping production-grade systems at scale, based in Melbourne, Australia. He is a Lead Consultant (Azure Cloud, DevOps & Platform) at Capgemini and the Founder of ADM Guard, a compliance SaaS platform for Australian Privacy Act automated decision transparency (APP 1.7–1.9).

## Core Work Pillars

1. **Azure Cloud + DevOps**: Enterprise Azure architecture, landing zones, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Terraform/Bicep IaC, Docker, Azure Functions, full-stack observability.
2. **Platform Engineering**: Developer platform velocity, large-scale enterprise migrations, microservices, SRE, zero-trust governance.
3. **Applied AI & AI Systems**: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Claude API, Google Gemini, AI Agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG architectures, vector databases.

## Featured Product: ADM Guard

- [ADM Guard](https://www.admguard.com.au): "The compliance flight recorder for automated decisions."
- Solves the mandatory Australian Privacy Act APP 1.7–1.9 transparency requirements.
- Architecture: Zero-PII ingestion boundary, SHA-256 Merkle hash chains, Azure Australia East WORM storage, client SDKs (TypeScript, Python, Go).
